summary: AB RETAIL AS (org. no. 837 319 862) is a private limited company (AS) based in Holmestrand, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-03-26. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.110 (Detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler); it has 14 registered employees. CEO: Øyvind Tybring Sørflakne Aralt; board chair: Øyvind Tybring Sørflakne Aralt; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS.
